How to practise well

By Jane Writer

Paragraph 1. Sustained practice beats occasional heroic effort, and the research on deliberate practice keeps pointing the same way: short, focused sessions with immediate feedback build skill faster than long unfocused ones. Pay attention to the details and keep a log.
